finding.expected: Make the review-decision workflow executable on the first TASK-063 publication event without requiring TASK-063 implementation to already exist on main. The executable publication logic must remain bound to the reviewed canonical lineage/event, preserve review-metadata separation, exact reviewed_sha publication, minimum repository authority, exact-SHA CAS protection, no verification/model/Executor invocation, and must not introduce a Human/manual bootstrap publication step.
finding.issue: The first repository-native publication cannot bootstrap itself. The review-decision push is handled by the workflow carried on the reviewed candidate, but the workflow explicitly checks out ref main before invoking python -m aios_renew.publication. At this TASK-063 revision-3 boundary, canonical main contains only the TASK contract and does not contain src/aios_renew/publication.py. Therefore the first PASS event would fail before the deterministic publication gate can run, so AC1 is not achieved and the same root cause prevents AC7's attributable publication report on bootstrap.
